slots_and_copies.name: profile_primary
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: FUN_080693b8 validates both mirrors independently via the whole-sector checksum invariant; returns index of the first valid copy, -1 if neither validates.

slots_and_copies.name: profile_backup
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Byte-identical mirror of profile_primary; written in the same FUN_08069194 call via a write-then-verify retry loop (up to 3 attempts). Not an independent save slot.

slots_and_copies.name: global_options_block
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single copy, no mirror. Written by FUN_08069298, read by FUN_080696c4. Confirmed in code only; region is blank (0xff) in both provided .sav samples, so layout/selection is unverified.

slots_and_copies.name: sram_format_stamp
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Fixed 32-byte ASCII stamp at the last 32 bytes of the 32KB SRAM chip; appears to mark the whole chip as formatted by this title/version, independent of either profile mirror.

checksums.name: profile_sector_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: 16-bit words of the full 0x2800-byte (5120-word) sector are summed with word[0] (the checksum field itself) zeroed; stored checksum = (bitwise-NOT of that sum) + seed_constant, mod 0x10000, little-endian, written back into word[0]. Equivalent invariant: sum of ALL words in the sector INCLUDING the stored checksum must equal (seed_constant - 1) mod 0x10000 for a valid sector.

checksums.name: global_options_block_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: Same ones'-complement-style sum/seed pattern as profile_sector_checksum (per FUN_08069298 decompilation), targeting the 0x2f80-byte global/options block. Not empirically verifiable: region is blank (0xff) in both provided samples.

fields.name: profile_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Recomputed on every profile write from the whole-sector word sum; see checksums[0].
fields.evidence: Algebraic derivation from FUN_08069194 matches both samples exactly via verify_checksum.py (see SAVE-FORMAT-REPORT.md section 4.3).

fields.name: generation_counter
fields.update_mechanism: psVar5[1] = (short)*piVar1, where piVar1 is incremented/clamped against a ROM ceiling constant each write.
fields.evidence: ghidra/decompiled.c:7107-7119; byte delta between the two samples is exactly +1.

fields.name: save_time_or_seed_u32
fields.update_mechanism: Copied verbatim from an unresolved RAM global (_DAT_08069238) at save time.
fields.evidence: Magnitude too large for a frame counter over the ~3.5s capture gap; plausibly a hardware timer/cycle count or RNG seed. Semantic meaning unproven.

fields.name: save_data_version_magic
fields.update_mechanism: Fixed ROM-constant string copied via FUN_080241fc on every write.
fields.evidence: FUN_080241fc copy length (0x20) and buffer offset (+8) match the exact byte range and content in both samples.
